metaDescription: Hospitality deserves better judgment, not more software. Why RADR exists.
heroLead: Hospitality is intensely human in front of the guest and brutally operational behind the scenes. Thousands of small decisions determine whether revenue becomes contribution. RADR exists to improve those decisions.
decisionsLead: Thousands of signals. A few decisions that materially change revenue, contribution, cost, guest experience and operational risk.
hospitalityLead1: Restaurants, hotels, and serviced apartments share one decision engine — different economics, same loop.
hospitalityLead2: That operating truth is the product thesis, not a vertical skin.

body: RADR was built to connect the evidence and show operators what matters.

why.metaTitle: Why RADR · Hospitality has a decision problem
why.metaDescription: The data already exists. The operating judgment is fragmented. RADR owns the decision lifecycle across systems.
why.leadProduce: The data already exists. The operating judgment is fragmented.
why.leadFragments: Each system knows a slice. The decision crosses all four.
why.leadFewAnswer: RADR owns the decision lifecycle — and answers:
questions: What happens if we do nothing?

territories.RECOVER: Credits, cancellations, uncollected and perishable value.

approach.metaTitle: Our approach · Not more data. Better decisions.
approach.metaDescription: RADR surfaces material decisions, plays futures forward, prepares action, and verifies value — then learns.
approach.heroLead: Nothing off the RADR. We connect operational reality to financial consequence, and turn it into action.

principles.title: Financial consequence first.
principles.body: Don't surface something merely because it changed. Surface it when it matters.

principles.title: Evidence before alerts.
principles.body: Every RADR finding should explain why it exists.

principles.title: Action over observation.
principles.body: A dashboard tells you what happened. RADR should help determine what happens next.

principles.title: Value must be provable.
principles.body: Identified value is not realized value. RADR distinguishes Identified, Protected and Verified.

identified.label: Identified
identified.desc: The financial difference is known and evidenced.

protected.label: Protected
protected.desc: A control or action is in place to stop recurrence.

verified.label: Verified
verified.desc: The value was actually captured, with proof.

securityPage.metaTitle: Trust & Security · Decision trust and honest controls
securityPage.metaDescription: Decision trust: evidence grades, human approval for material actions, Verified Value chain — plus the access and data controls that actually exist.
securityPage.heroLead: RADR separates OBSERVED, ESTIMATED, OPERATOR CONTEXT, PREDICTED, RECOMMENDED and VERIFIED. Predictions are estimates — not guarantees. Human approval for material actions. No Verified Value without an evidence chain.

stages.example: 4 premium rooms open · direct pace ahead of OTA
€3,100 expected protected if premium direct hold holds
Revenue manager: corporate release expected tomorrow
D-2201 · Hold premium direct 72h — not OTA release

securityPage.uncertaintyTitle: What if reality does something else?
securityPage.uncertaintyLead: RADR compares predicted vs actual, then updates. Humility is a feature.
securityPage.uncertaintyNote: RADR does not need to be right every time. It needs to measure when it was wrong — and learn.
securityPage.modelNote: Model confidence is designed to reflect the model, sample size, and data freshness. Evidence coverage is factual. They are not the same.
securityPage.opsNote: RADR provides operational decision support. It is not investment, legal, tax, or regulated financial advice. Managers approve material actions.

privateStorage.label: Private document storage
privateStorage.detail: Uploaded PDFs and images are stored in private object storage (or a private local store in development), not public buckets.

orgIsolation.label: Organization isolation
orgIsolation.detail: Document and account access is scoped to the authenticated organization membership on the server.

serverAuthz.label: Server-side authorization
serverAuthz.detail: Protected routes and APIs check session and membership before returning sensitive data.

controlledDocs.label: Controlled document access
controlledDocs.detail: Document reads and downloads require authentication; access paths are not publicly enumerable.

sessionAuth.label: Session authentication
sessionAuth.detail: Account sessions are handled by Better Auth with server-side session validation.

auditExports.label: Advanced audit exports
auditExports.detail: Exportable audit trails for operators and finance teams.

securityPage.certNote: No SOC 2 or ISO certification claims are made here. GDPR is a legal framework, not a certification we claim. When formal certifications exist, they will be listed with dates and scope.
securityPage.trustLead: Operators should know what is fact, what is estimate, and what still needs a human.

trustPrinciples.title: Evidence before advice
trustPrinciples.detail: Material recommendations are designed to carry sources, freshness, drivers and confidence — not chatty tips.

trustPrinciples.title: Grade every claim
trustPrinciples.detail: OBSERVED · ESTIMATED · PREDICTED · RECOMMENDED · VERIFIED stay distinct. RADR does not blur them.

trustPrinciples.title: Human approval for material actions
trustPrinciples.detail: Prepared for approval is not execution. External action only through supported systems and organization policy.

trustPrinciples.title: Verified Value chain
trustPrinciples.detail: Potential stays separate until observed proof lands. RADR claims only what the operation can prove.

securityPage.controlsLead: Only controls that actually exist. Status is LIVE or IN DEVELOPMENT — never aspirational theater.

founder.quote: I thought I wanted to open a restaurant. What I really wanted was to make hospitality work better.
founder.name: Daniel Do
founder.body: Grew up close to hospitality through a family food business, worked in hospitality, then technology and sales. The deeper problem was not another venue — it was the operating system behind thousands of venues. RADR is the larger expression of that obsession.
